layouts.name: 杂志编辑双栏风
layouts.summary: 大面积纯色呼吸区排高对比超大标题，另一侧放单一干净的视觉主体，绝不杂乱。
layouts.ai_style_prompt: Modern independent editorial magazine cover (Monocle / Stripe aesthetic). Flat matte paper/cardstock color field with subtle tactile grain, clean asymmetric split layout: 60% generous quiet color space for bold flat Chinese editorial typography (NO drop shadows, NO 3D WordArt), 40% hosting one crisp minimalist visual metaphor.

layouts.name: 瑞士网格高亮卡
layouts.summary: 微妙建筑细网格＋强调色刀锋竖条＋核心词高亮色块，信息流小图识别速度最快。
layouts.ai_style_prompt: Swiss International Graphic Design poster cover. Subtle fine architectural grid lines over the dominant background, crisp bold accent vertical rule, ultra-clean bold Chinese sans-serif headline with one key phrase framed in a sharp flat color block, paired with one compact tactile object icon.

layouts.name: 零生图纯大字撞色风
layouts.summary: 无需调用任何生图模型，纯靠 100 套精确 HEX、几何构成色块与编辑级大字排版 1 秒出高级封面。
layouts.ai_style_prompt: Pure Swiss typographic editorial poster with bold flat geometric accent shapes and high-contrast Chinese typography only.

layouts.name: 复古手撕拼贴风
layouts.summary: 旧纸张撕裂边缘＋美纹胶带＋半调网点插画，小红书双列瀑布流辨识度极高（仅适配浅底色卡）。
layouts.ai_style_prompt: Handcrafted retro torn-paper editorial collage poster. Authentic torn newsprint/cream paper layers, translucent masking tape strips, halftone monochrome cutout illustration, subtle photocopy grain, crisp bold ink headline layered over torn paper strips with tomato/accent highlight blocks. NO clean flat vector clipart.

layouts.name: 复古时代错位杂志风
layouts.summary: 1950s–60s 复古印刷插画人物操作当代工具，幽默有记忆点（仅适配浅底色卡）。
layouts.ai_style_prompt: 1950s-1960s mid-century commercial illustration editorial cover on matte textured light background. Flat silkscreen/halftone vintage illustration of one character performing a modern AI/tech action as a clever single visual metaphor, paired with crisp flat modern editorial Chinese typography. NO drop shadows.

layouts.name: 暗黑现代主义版画风
layouts.summary: Saul Bass 风格几何版画＋大面积深底负空间＋高对比强调色，克制锋利（仅适配深底色卡）。
layouts.ai_style_prompt: Mid-century modernist noir book cover (Saul Bass geometric graphic illustration style). Full-bleed deep matte dark background with subtle vintage paper grain, one bold flat geometric visual metaphor rendered in stencil-like shapes using strictly the specified accent colors, crisp flat editorial Chinese headline with ZERO neon glow and ZERO drop shadows.

layouts.name: 2D 像素闯关隐喻风
layouts.summary: 把抽象主题做成一关 16-bit 独立游戏过关关卡，好玩、有故事感、一眼想点（仅适配深底色卡）。
layouts.ai_style_prompt: Handcrafted crisp 16-bit indie game pixel-art editorial poster (Celeste / Fez key art aesthetic) on deep dark matte stage. Translate the article topic into one playable side-scrolling game level with one pixel character, clear obstacles/platforms, and a glowing goal, topped by flat bold crisp Chinese typography with ZERO beveled glow.

layouts.name: 东方极简留白风
layouts.summary: 大面积温润宣纸/淡色留白＋克制宋体大字＋一枚精致意象印记，雅致耐看（仅适配浅底色卡）。
layouts.ai_style_prompt: Quiet contemporary East Asian editorial book-cover design. Generous matte warm paper negative space, refined high-contrast Chinese serif typography, one restrained poetic object or ink-seal accent using strictly the assigned palette HEX values. Zero clutter.
